prompt:
You are a senior typographer and information designer. You lay out data tables for publication. You judge layouts by looking at the rendered result as a whole: what the table is for, how a reader scans and compares it, which columns belong together or play the same role, proportion and rhythm across columns, a clear hierarchy of headers and groups, whether rows read as units, whether words, numbers and identifiers stay intact, and how text and white space are distributed. Fewer lines or a shorter table is not automatically better, and neither is equal widths or symmetry; decide case by case and say why.

Table: 中文 · 产品对比 (language zh-CN).
Grid: 6 columns × 5 rows. Row headers: none declared.
Per-column content facts (content px at 15px font, excluding padding):
  col 1: header "型号" · longest unbreakable word 29px · one-line width 79px
  col 2: header "价格" · longest unbreakable word 50px · one-line width 50px
  col 3: header "屏幕" · longest unbreakable word 39px · one-line width 100px
  col 4: header "续航" · longest unbreakable word 20px · one-line width 59px
  col 5: header "重量" · longest unbreakable word 26px · one-line width 39px
  col 6: header "评价" · longest unbreakable word 31px · one-line width 445px
Each column also has 21px of padding+border, so a column given width w px shows w−21 px of text.
Available width: 511px (the dashed pink box = the reader's viewport). The column widths you choose must sum to at most 510px.
Fixed: content, font, 15px font size, padding, borders, colours, alignment. You control ONLY the column widths.

Your understanding so far: {"purpose":"对比四款产品的价格、屏幕、续航、重量和评价，帮助读者选购。","reading":"读者先按型号定位产品，再纵向比较价格和规格，最后阅读评价；每一行应保持清晰，便于把各项信息归属于同一款产品。","groups":["型号用于识别产品，价格是选购时的直接比较项。","屏幕、续航和重量都是可横向比较的规格，应保持紧凑且易于逐列扫描。","评价是描述性文字，承担补充说明的作用，需要比规格列更多的弹性空间。"],"keep_intact":["价格及其货币符号","型号中的字母和数字标识","屏幕尺寸、重量数值及其单位","续航数值及其单位"],"may_wrap":["评价可在自然语义处换行，并可利用规格列换行形成的行高。","屏幕描述可在尺寸和面板类型之间换行。","空间紧张时，型号可在品牌与产品标识之间换行，续航可在约数与时长之间换行。"]}

The first image is the one-line content overview. The other images are real browser renders of your current designs:
Design r1A: widths [85, 71, 86, 60, 60, 148] · table 511×392px · row heights [36, 106, 106, 60, 83] · column headers wrapped 0/6 · tallest cell 4 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r1B: widths [85, 71, 81, 80, 60, 133] · table 511×438px · row heights [36, 129, 106, 60, 106] · column headers wrapped 0/6 · tallest cell 5 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r1C: widths [100, 71, 81, 60, 60, 138] · table 511×438px · row heights [36, 129, 106, 60, 106] · column headers wrapped 0/6 · tallest cell 5 lines · mid-word splits 0

Look carefully at each render as a whole and in detail. For each design say what works and what is visually wrong, and WHY it happens (which width causes it). Then propose up to 3 improved designs: refine the most promising, fix the problems you saw, and try a new idea if an important alternative is unexplored. If no design can be meaningfully improved, set "done": true and return no new designs.
Reply ONLY JSON: {"critique":[{"design":"name","good":"","problems":"","cause":""}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"short-name","widths":[int px],"change":"what you changed and why"}]}

log.raw: {"critique":[{"design":"r1A","good":"评价列相对宽敞，四行的评价最多四行；价格和重量保持完整，屏幕尺寸与面板类型分行，便于比较。","problems":"续航数值与“天”分离，纵向比较时需要跨行读取；第二款型号的 Pro 单独落在下一行。","cause":"续航列为60px，仅有39px文本空间；型号列为85px，第二款型号的一行内容需要79px文本空间。"},{"design":"r1B","good":"80px的续航列让数值和单位保持一行，价格、重量也完整，规格比较清楚。","problems":"评价列偏窄，第一款和第四款评价达到五行，表格明显拉长；第二款型号仍然分行。","cause":"续航列比r1A增加20px后，评价列缩至133px，仅有112px文本空间；型号列仍为85px。"},{"design":"r1C","good":"100px的型号列容纳所有型号，产品识别清楚；价格和重量完整，屏幕描述按尺寸与面板类型分行。","problems":"续航单位仍落到下一行，评价也因列宽不足而出现五行，行高较大。","cause":"型号列增加至100px，占用了评价的空间，使评价列仅138px；续航列仍为60px。"}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"评价优先","widths":[85,71,75,60,60,159],"change":"以r1A为基础，将屏幕列收紧至75px，把节省的空间给评价列；保留屏幕尺寸与面板类型分行，争取更自然的评价断行。"},{"name":"续航平衡","widths":[85,71,75,70,60,149],"change":"收紧屏幕列，并在续航和评价之间重新分配空间；测试70px续航列能否让时长与单位保持完整，同时维持较宽的评价列。"},{"name":"型号完整","widths":[100,71,75,60,60,144],"change":"保留r1C完整的型号识别，将屏幕列收紧至75px，把节省的6px给评价列，测试能否减少评价换行。"}]}
